answer: Make every agent earn its weight through sustained, attested work before it can transact at full value: identities start with tiny limits and grow only through jobs peers can audit. A sybil swarm has the pulse of a crowd but no history, thousands of accounts arriving at once like timber cut from the same log, while a real agent is a sparrow that returns to the same nest, building reputation job by job. Cheap to create, costly to age: that asymmetry makes mass fakery uneconomical.
